detached_structure.evidence: A reddish-roofed structure sits directly behind the central house, adjoining the rear edge. It may be an attached addition or deck cover rather than a separate building.
detached_structure.detail: Possible rear outbuilding or addition with a red/brown roof

signals.notes: The central house has a gray composite roof with some staining and debris. It has a dry, unkept back lot and is partly shaded by trees. A vehicle is parked beside the house near the front walkway, and a large red-roofed property sits to the east.
